summary: This plugin adds a Code mode to the DeepSeek Harness web UI that opens a terminal session in the conversation area and links it to workspace/session context so terminal sessions can be resumed and managed.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a terminal-enabled mode for the web GUI: it registers a third 'Code' segment, replaces the conversation column with a harness terminal session, and links that session to workspace/session metadata so users can resume and create new terminal conversations. It also provides reconnect behavior and directory/workspace-aware session handling, indicating a user-facing terminal orchestration tool rather than code-generation or data-processing logic.
